description: This Go source file implements the StatusManager service, responsible for managing, reconciling, and fetching agent statuses within an internal control plane. It handles live health checks, caching, status updates, state transitions, event broadcasting, and periodic reconciliation to ensure consistent and accurate agent state representation.

classes.name: StatusManager
classes.description: The StatusManager manages agent statuses, including live checks, caching, state transitions, and event broadcasting. It periodically reconciles statuses with storage, handles status updates, and manages transitions with timeout checks.

classes.name: StatusEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling status change events, allowing custom handlers to respond to status updates.

classes.name: cachedAgentStatus
classes.description: Internal struct used to cache agent status with a timestamp for intelligent cache invalidation.

methods.name: NewStatusManager
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new StatusManager instance with provided storage, config, UI service, and agent client

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the background processes for monitoring and reconciling statuses.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of an agent, performing a live health check if cache is stale or not available.

methods.name: GetAgentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a cached or stored snapshot of an agent’s status without performing a live check, designed for fast UI responses.

methods.name: UpdateAgentStatus
methods.description: Updates agent status based on new data, handles state transitions, persists changes, and broadcasts events.

methods.name: UpdateFromHeartbeat
methods.description: Updates the agent status based on heartbeat data, with intelligent handling to avoid overwriting recent offline status.

methods.name: RefreshAgentStatus
methods.description: Forces a cache refresh and recomputes agent status, then broadcasts a refresh event.

methods.name: AddEventHandler
methods.description: Registers a new status event handler.

methods.name: handleStateTransition
methods.description: Manages safe state transitions with validation, transition tracking, and immediate completion if appropriate.

methods.name: persistStatus
methods.description: Persist the current agent status to storage, enforcing consistency between status and lifecycle status.

methods.name: notifyStatusChanged
methods.description: Invokes all registered event handlers in response to status changes.

methods.name: broadcastStatusEvents
methods.description: Emits detailed events about status changes for external systems and UI updates.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Periodic loop that triggers reconciliation of agent statuses based on defined intervals.

methods.name: performReconciliation
methods.description: Checks all agents and reconciles their statuses based on heartbeat freshness and other conditions.

methods.name: needsReconciliation
methods.description: Determines if an agent requires status reconciliation based on last heartbeat and status consistency.

methods.name: reconcileAgentStatus
methods.description: Updates a specific agent's status based on heartbeat age and stored state.

methods.name: transitionTimeoutLoop
methods.description: Manages timeout checks for stuck state transitions.

methods.name: checkTransitionTimeouts
methods.description: Forces completion of transitions that exceed maximum allowed duration.
